signals.summary: Chobani announced plans to invest about $1.2B over five years in a 1.5M sq ft manufacturing facility. The Food Business News topic page ties this to an Allentown campus. The snippet I saw was truncated, and the page it came from was a soccer-sponsorship press release.
Chobani launched La Colombe Matcha Lattes in three flavors: Vanilla, Strawberry and a third (probably classic matcha).
Chobani is bringing back Peppermint Mocha Coffee Creamer. It is also releasing Pistachio Chocolate Coffee Creamer as its fourth and final Flavor Drop of the year.
Chobani launched High Protein Drinks in 6 flavors with 20g or 30g of protein. The post's title mentions a $20M investment in a facility. The post is undated, so the timing is unconfirmed.

Chobani has open roles in Twin Falls (production supervisor, HTST operator), Philadelphia (procurement manager covering new product launches) and New York (eCommerce). These suggest continued manufacturing and supply chain hiring.

answer.notes: Chobani's job postings say it acquired Daily Harvest in 2025. That is outside the 90-day window, so I did not list it as a signal. The Food Business News page also mentions 'Chobani raises $650 million', but I couldn't confirm the date, so I left it out. It may be older. The $1.2B investment is the strongest hook, but I couldn't open the primary press release. Confirm the location (Allentown, PA) and the details before citing them. One search failed, and I hit the search limit before I could verify further. I found no leadership change or layoff signals, but I didn't search for them specifically.
